title: Select idea for the pipeline
decision: Enter Stage 01 with candidate B: a Telegram-first two-sided credit ledger for mahalla shops, positioned around repayment
context: Five candidates built on the nasiya ledger practice were scored against nine criteria; see docs/idea-selection/OUTPUT.md
rationale: Highest total score (33 of 45): addresses collection, low install friction, feasible MVP, no licensing exposure. Demand itself remains unvalidated.
evidence: EVID-001, EVID-003, EVID-004, EVID-009, EVID-012, EVID-013
